header: Terms and descriptions, pair by pair
lead: A real dl with dt and dd pairs, so screen readers announce each description with its term. Two, three or four columns, up to 40 rows.

entries.title: The term
entries.text: It is set apart in weight and colour, so the two sides stay easy to tell apart in a long list.

entries.title: The value
entries.text: Keep it short: a number, a unit or a few words.

entries.title: The explanation
entries.text: When a value is not enough, this longer line sits under it in smaller text.

entries.title: The wrapper
entries.text: It keeps a term and its description in one grid cell, so a pair never splits across two columns.
